analysis: coordinator/internal/registry/kvbudget/pool.go (patch at lines 31-36, 70-86, 147-157): comment updates plus a parameter rename (reportedRate to modelRate) in ResolveRate. The logic is unchanged: ClampRate still bounds the rate to 16 MiB per token, the cold-model fallback is still max(default, largest resident rate), and non-byte-mode pools still return 0. The new comments mention an 'explicit cold forecast' that is stored in the rate table, but no code path that sets such a forecast is in this diff. A later pass should check that any forecast is clamped via ClampRate, since an unclamped value could overflow in AddByteCharge or understate KV charges. CHANGELOG.md (head text, lines 1059-1726) is documentation only, with no code behaviour change. Two items touch T-041: the 100 GiB default SSD cache ceiling at line 1059 conflicts with the 'no fixed ceiling' baseline, and the default-on complete Qwen checkpoint SSD storage plus the coordinator holder index and routing (lines 1061-1071) is not covered by the sign-off. Neither the CHANGELOG patch nor the provider and coordinator code behind these claims was supplied, so the claims are unverified and the findings are low severity. Coverage limit: the Swift and coordinator cache routing source needs review. Other changelog entries (profiler T-051, runtime manifest union, fan control) match existing threat entries and were not re-audited.

findings.detail: CHANGELOG.md line 1059 says the default shared SSD cache ceiling is raised to 100 GiB, limited to half the available space. T-041 (b) and its mitigations, re-checked against PR #866, describe the default as available-disk/2 with no fixed ceiling and a 20 GiB fallback. Either the ceiling is a new bound or the threat model is stale. The at-rest window and the 20 GiB pre-write reserve semantics are used in the SEC-035 sign-off, so the threat model should be reconciled. Fix by confirming the code behaviour and updating T-041 and the detection_hint, or correcting the changelog.
findings.title: Changelog states a 100 GiB SSD cache ceiling that conflicts with the T-041 disk-budget baseline

findings.detail: CHANGELOG.md lines 1061-1062 add default-on encrypted SSD storage of complete dense Qwen and Qwen MoE prefix checkpoints, including recurrent state and attention KV. Lines 1066-1067 and 1070-1071 add coordinator-side content-indexed holders across machine epochs, routing on actual checkpoint endpoints, and an optional operator allowlist. T-041 describes only per-block DBK3 artifacts with per-donation gating. Checkpoint artifacts carry more model state per file and extend the same-account TTFT oracle. The cross-machine holder index adds a new routing-evidence surface. The tenant, expiry and artifact checks the changelog says are preserved should be verified in code. Update T-041 and its detection_hint to cover the checkpoint codec, its lookup-tag derivation, the holder index and the allowlist.
findings.title: Default-on complete Qwen checkpoint SSD storage widens the at-rest artifact class beyond the T-041 sign-off
